what_for.text: It lowers 'bad' cholesterol levels in your blood.
what_for.evidence: Nilemdo is a medicine that lowers levels of ‘bad’ cholesterol (also called “LDL-cholesterol”), a type of fat, in the blood.

what_for.text: It lowers high blood cholesterol in adults with hypercholesterolaemia.
what_for.evidence: Adults with primary hypercholesterolaemia or mixed dyslipidaemia, which are conditions that cause a high cholesterol level in the blood.

how_to_use.text: Take one tablet once every day.
how_to_use.evidence: The recommended dose is one tablet once daily.

how_to_use.text: Swallow the tablet whole with food or between meals.
how_to_use.evidence: Swallow the tablet whole with food or between meals.

how_to_use.text: If you remember late, take the missed dose that day.
how_to_use.evidence: a dose late in a day, take the missed dose and take the next dose at your regular time the next day.

how_to_use.text: If missed yesterday, take your regular dose today.
how_to_use.evidence: the previous day’s dose, take your tablet at the regular time and do not make up for the forgotten dose.

how_to_use.text: Do not stop taking Nilemdo without your doctor's permission.
how_to_use.evidence: Do not stop taking Nilemdo without your doctor’s permission as your cholesterol may rise again.

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you have unexplained muscle pain.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Tell your doctor immediately about any unexplained muscle pain, tenderness or weakness.

see_doctor_now.text: If you take too much, contact your doctor immediately.
see_doctor_now.evidence: If you take more Nilemdo than you should ... Contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately.

side_effects.text: Commonly, it may cause lower red blood cell counts.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... lower number of red blood cells (anaemia)

side_effects.text: Commonly, it may cause gout or increased uric acid.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... increased levels of uric acid in blood, gout

side_effects.text: Commonly, it may cause pain in shoulders, legs, or arms.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... pain in shoulders, legs, or arms

side_effects.text: Uncommonly, it may cause weight loss.
side_effects.evidence: Uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people) ... weight loss

storage.text: Keep this medicine out of children's sight and reach.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.

storage.text: This medicine does not require any special storage conditions.
storage.evidence: This medicine does not require any special storage conditions.

storage.text: Do not use after the expiry date on the pack.
storage.evidence: Do not use this medicine after the expiry date which is stated on the blister and carton after EXP.
